name: Explosive Consultation
summary: Alba Fairmoon sends you to find a way to stop the poison spreading from the Deadmines into Westfall's fields. In Stormwind's Dwarven District, you seek an engineer who can make the heavy explosives the work requires.

sections.title: A Toxic Source
sections.body: Westfall's poisoned fields lead back to caustic toxins and industrial refuse in the Deadmines. Reinforced machinery guards the underground works, and ordinary weapons cannot disable it. Heavy explosives could break through that machinery and halt the poisoning.

sections.title: Seeking Stormwind's Expertise
sections.body: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, you seek Sprite Jumpsprocket, an engineer able to devise the needed explosives. Roaring forges, tinkerers, and merchants selling blasting powder fill the district. Its craftsmen may know how to stop the Deadmines operation.

faq.q: Why do we need explosives in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Evidence from Westfall points to a large industrial operation in the Deadmines, where toxins foul nearby farmland. Heavy explosives can disable its reinforced machinery.
Alba Fairmoon sends heroes to investigate the unnatural contaminants and unrest threatening Westfall.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is a gnome engineer in Stormwind's Dwarven District. She works with complex mechanical devices and volatile compounds, and can craft powerful demolitions.

faq.q: Why travel to the Dwarven District for help?
faq.answer: Stormwind's Dwarven District is the city's industrial heart. Skilled blacksmiths and tinkerers work there, alongside sellers of blasting powder and engineering components.

faq.q: Does Stormwind's government assist with this effort?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, the House of Nobles is reluctant to send formal military garrisons to Westfall. Local defenders rely on independent volunteers and private craftsmen in the capital rather than regular army regiments.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know brute force cannot solve Westfall's poisoned-land troubles. Disabling large underground machinery calls for specialized munitions and careful technical skill.
As a gnome, you bring technological ingenuity that can help counter underground industrial threats beyond the reach of regular Alliance forces.
As an Alliance member, you see Westfall's struggling frontier communities rely on the workshops of Stormwind's Dwarven District.
